name: IEA 15MW UMaine VolturnUS-S
subtitle: Floating · Class IB · 15 MW
description: IEA 15-240-RWT reference turbine on the UMaine VolturnUS-S semi-submersible platform. Hub height 150 m, rotor diameter 240 m. Floating offshore configuration from the IEA Wind Task 37 reference turbine series.
notes: CompServo=0 (open-loop). To enable closed-loop ROSCO control: set CompServo=1 in the .fst file — libdiscon.dylib, IEA-15-240-RWT-UMaineSemi_DISCON.IN, and Cp_Ct_Cq.IEA15MW.txt are already bundled. The shared IEA-15-240-RWT/ sibling directory contains blade, airfoil, and Cp/Ct/Cq data referenced by relative path from the model.
